name: Mitya
desc: An exceptionally ingenious energy specialist and a master of the fine art of "schedule-dodging."

skills.name: Chain Reaction
skills.desc:
Normal Attack
Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG to the area in front after a short casting time. Mitya will instead perform the special Charged Attack Gradient Detonation, which consumes no Stamina, if a {LINK#N11360002}Detection Core: Overload{/LINK} created by Mitya is currently on the field and he has at least 1 {LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}: Deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG to the area in front and continuously consumes Gradient Beacons while held. Each Gradient Beacon consumed deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG to the area in front that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Electro DMG upon impact.

desc: Gradient Detonation Stellar-Conduct DMG|{param10:F1P} Elemental Mastery

skills.name: Principle: Variable Detection
skills.desc: Summons a Detection Core that follows the current active character. When a nearby party member triggers an Electro-Charged, Overload, or Superconduct reaction, the Detection Core accumulates charge. Once fully charged, it converts into Detection Core: Overload, dealing AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

passives.name: Baseline Stress Test
passives.desc: The {LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK} created by the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection is enhanced. Depending on the state of the Detection Core created:\n·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 30 Elemental Mastery for each {LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK} Mitya has;\n·Overloaded: After nearby party members trigger Stellar-Conduct reactions, instead obtain 1 Gradient Beacon every 1.5s for 6s.

passives.name: Explosive Reagent: Safe Limits Exceeded
passives.desc: The duration of {LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK} is increased to 10s. Additionally, Mitya's CRIT Rate increases by 5% for 15s after creating a Gradient Beacon. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

constellations.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing
constellations.desc: The maximum number of {LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK} Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection additionally creates 1 Gradient Beacon.\nWhile the {LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK} is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.\nAdditionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a Gradient Beacon is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

constellations.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology
constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11362}Principle: Variable Detection{/LINK} by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
